svg.title: Let M(d) a : E≤d →E≤a, 0 ≤a ≤d, be the fixed homogeneous splitting maps, with their inclusion maps between grade caps. The contact route construction for homogeneous labels is multilinear in each input. To see this before integration, fix all other inputs; its grade-transport identity expresses the remaining dependence as a linear map. Hence addition and scalar multiplication hold in that slot for the full expression-valued score.
